feature.description: Start a new entity or area: its libraries (models, data-access, ui, util, testing, feature-shell), pages, and the app's route, API config provider, nav entries and sitemap entry.

library.description: A library of one type (models, data-access, ui, util, testing, feature-shell) in this workspace's layout, with its tags and starter files.

page.description: A page (view-all, view, create, edit, blank) in a feature's feature-shell, with its route and pageMeta title/description.
